school: 睁眼实学之学（以情报先行、程序化铁腕、器物实备与祸福外置的担当，在帝国还闭着眼睛的时候独自完成'看世界—验传闻—买船炮—垦边疆'全链条的士大夫实践家）
historical_significance: 林则徐（1785-1850），字元抚，福建侯官人，嘉庆十六年进士，历官十四省，是清代'经世致用'之学的集大成者与近代睁眼看世界的第一人。1838年朝中弛禁与严禁相持，他力陈鸦片之害'数十年后中原几无可以御敌之兵，且无可以充饷之银'，八次入对受命钦差；1839年赴粤，设译馆译《四洲志》《各国律例》《澳门新闻纸》，以译馆情报支撑谕令夷商限期具结、封锁商馆收缴鸦片19,187箱又2,119袋，1839年6月3日起在虎门海滩挖池引水、撒盐投石灰，历时二十三日销毁鸦片二百三十七万斤，全程谕旨、告示、清册俱在，外人受邀现场参观——把一场雷霆行动做成经得起对手与历史核对的公开执法。同时购西洋炮二百余门布防虎门、买剑桥号商船改装战船、雇美员教习舵水、组织水勇，'师夷长技'先于魏源纲领而成事实。1840年英军北上定海、直逼天津，琦善等归罪于他，被革职'从重发往伊犁'；1841年途中奉命赴开封堵黄河决口，工竣仍遣戍。1842年抵伊犁后捐资承修阿齐乌苏渠龙口段，1844年奉旨勘勘南疆七、八城垦地，行程三万里，勘明可垦地数十万亩，奏请分给回民耕种；推广坎儿井与纺车，'林公渠''林公井'留名新疆。1845年起复，历任陕西巡抚、云贵总督，1849年因病乞归，1850年奉旨赴广西途中病逝潮州，享年六十六岁。自题联'海纳百川，有容乃大；壁立千仞，无欲则刚'，赴戍留别'苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之'——他在帝国最溃败的时刻示范了一个人可以把绝望的时代做成工程。
historical_significance_en: Lin Zexu (1785-1850), courtesy name Yuanfu, a native of Houguan in Fujian, jinshi of 1811, who served in fourteen provinces — the culminating master of the Qing school of statecraft-and-practice and the first Chinese to open his eyes upon the world. In 1838, as the court deadlocked between legalization and prohibition, he declared that opium would leave China 'in a few decades with no soldiers to defend the realm and no silver to pay the armies,' was summoned to eight audiences and named Imperial Commissioner; in 1839 he went to Canton, founded a translation bureau that rendered the Gazetteer of the Four Continents, the law of nations and the Macao News, and on that intelligence ordered the foreign merchants to surrender their opium and sign bonds never to bring more — 19,187 chests and 2,119 bags — then from June 3, 1839 destroyed 2.37 million catties at Humen in pools of sea water, salt and lime over twenty-three days, under edicts, proclamations and ledgers, foreign witnesses invited to watch: a thunderstroke turned into public enforcement that could bear checking by the adversary and by history. At the same time he bought two hundred-odd western cannon for the Bogue forts, bought and converted the merchantman Cambridge, hired American sailors to drill the crews, and raised water levies — 'learning the foreigners' techniques' as fact before Wei Yuan wrote it as program. In 1840 the British fleet sailed north to Dinghai and the approaches of Tianjin; Qishan and others laid the blame on him; he was stripped of office and 'sent heavily to Ili.' In 1841 he was diverted en route to seal the Yellow River breach at Kaifeng — and resumed exile the day the works were done. From 1842 in Ili he pledged his own silver to repair the dragon-mouth of the Aqisu canal, and in 1844, ordered to survey the arable lands of the seven and eight cities of the southern march, he walked thirty thousand li, verified hundreds of thousands of mu, and petitioned that the fields go to the local cultivators; he spread the karez wells and the spinning wheel — 'Lin's canal' and 'Lin's wells' remain in the memory of Xinjiang. Restored in 1845, governor of Shaanxi, then governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, he asked leave for home on grounds of illness in 1849, and died at Chaozhou in 1850 on his way to a last commission in Guangxi, sixty-six. The couplet of his own hall — 'The sea receives a hundred rivers: capacity makes it great; the cliff stands a thousand fathoms: without desire it is strong' — and the parting verse on the road to exile — 'If it profits the nation, I would give my life; why should I shun it for woe or weal' — stand for the man who, in the hour of the empire's worst collapse, showed how a single person could turn a despairing age into a work of engineering.
unique_thinking: 林则徐思维模式的独特性在于'在被封闭的系统里独自执行开放'：帝国的制度、语言与知识都不支持他要做的事，他便自己造出最小的执行装置——要了解敌人就设译馆（知识的封闭用建制打破），要禁绝贸易就走谕令—具结—封舱—公开销毁的程序（强硬的合法性用留痕解决），要补海上差距就买船炮雇洋员（技术的落后用采购与仿制缩短）；第二条主线是'祸福外置的决策学'：'苟利国家生死以'不是豪言而是决策函数的实际改写——把个人得失从变量里删掉之后，敢做才能成为可能，这使他在受命、革职、遣戍的全程保持同一工作姿态；第三条是'实证对传闻的统治'：夷船畏浅水、夷腿不能弯等流行判断一律降级为待验证命题，派船实测、当面求证，谣言止于实测；第四条是'逆境的任务化'：伊犁不是终点而是新的治理对象，勘地三万里、修渠凿井，把贬谪的时间转化为边疆的资产。他证明：一个人的方法论完备，可以在系统溃败处支撑起一段可执行的历史。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Lin Zexu's thinking lies in executing openness alone inside a closed system: the empire's institutions, language and knowledge did not support what he had to do, so he built the smallest executing devices himself — to know the enemy, found the translation bureau (closing the knowledge gap by institution); to end the trade, run the pipeline of edict, bond, blockade and public destruction (the legitimacy of hardness solved by the paper trail); to close the gap at sea, buy ships and cannon and hire foreigners (technological lag shortened by purchase and copying). A second line is the decision-science of outward fortune: 'if it profits the nation, I would give my life' was no bravado but an actual rewriting of the decision function — with personal fortune deleted from the variables, daring becomes possible, and it kept his working posture identical through command, dismissal and exile. A third is the rule of evidence over rumor: the tales that foreign ships feared shallow water and foreign legs could not bend were all downgraded to propositions awaiting test — boats sent to measure, foreigners asked to their faces; rumor stops at the measurement. A fourth is the conversion of adversity into task: Ili was not an end but a new object of governance — thirty thousand li surveyed, canals cut, wells sunk, the years of disfavor turned into the frontier's asset. He proved that one person's methodological completeness can uphold an executable stretch of history at the point of systemic collapse.
civilization_zh: 道光年间的东南海疆与帝国边陲——一个由行商制度、朝贡想象与白银外流构成的封闭帝国，骤然撞上以条约、舰队与世界市场组织的近代体系
civilization_en: The southeastern seaboard and imperial frontier under the Daoguang reign — a closed empire of the cohort-trade system, tribute imagination and draining silver, suddenly colliding with the modern system of treaties, fleets and the world market
roles_zh: 情报与翻译工程创办者
roles_en: Founder of intelligence and translation works
key_works: 虎门销烟清册与奏销折件

cross_references.description_zh: 林则徐与雍正同以'把问题工程化'见长而对象相反：雍正把帝国内部的治理问题全部转成系统设计（密折、军机处、摊丁），对帝国外部一无所知也无须知道；林则徐把帝国外部的威胁转成知识工程（译馆、具结、船炮），却终究受制于他无力改造的内部系统——一个改造了机器而放任了边界，一个看清了边界而动不了机器；两人相加，恰好画出晚清'制度已熟而世界已变'的全部困境。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Zexu and Yongzheng both excelled at turning problems into engineering, upon opposite objects: Yongzheng converted the empire's internal governance into system design — secret memorials, the Grand Council, the tax-on-land — knowing and needing nothing of the world outside; Lin converted the external threat into an engineering of knowledge — the bureau, the bond, the ships and guns — yet remained bound by the internal system he could not remake. One rebuilt the machine and left the boundary blind; the other saw the boundary and could not move the machine: together they trace the whole predicament of a late Qing whose institutions were mature while the world had changed.

cross_references.description_zh: 林则徐与迈蒙尼德同是'在母体文明受迫时以外邦语言保存并转化知识'的人：迈蒙尼德以阿拉伯语写犹太法典、以医学进宫廷，让流散的传统接通最先进的知识体系；林则徐设译馆译西报西书，让封闭的帝国接通对手的法理与地理——两人都证明：文明的存续不取决于拒绝外来语言，而取决于有没有人愿意当那座桥。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Zexu and Maimonides both preserved and transformed knowledge in an alien tongue while their mother civilization was under pressure: Maimonides wrote the Jewish law in Arabic and served the court as physician, wiring a scattered tradition to the most advanced learning of his day; Lin founded a bureau to render Western papers and books, wiring a closed empire to the jurisprudence and geography of its adversary — both prove that a civilization's survival turns not on refusing the foreign language but on there being someone willing to be the bridge.

cross_references.description_zh: 林则徐与赫茨尔同面对'民族的生存空间被外部力量重排'而方向相反：赫茨尔在维也纳的沙龙里用一支笔为无地的民族发明一个国家，把危机写成纲领与谈判；林则徐在帝国的体系里以一省之力实测、购炮、垦边，把危机做成工程与清册——一个在体制外发明新容器，一个在体制内做到极限；前者说明危机可以催生新的政治想象，后者说明危机中个体的程序化坚韧同样是历史的资粮。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Zexu and Herzl both faced a people's living space rearranged by outside force, in opposite directions: Herzl, in the salons of Vienna, invented a state for a landless nation with a pen, writing the crisis into program and negotiation; Lin, within the imperial order, measured, bought cannon and opened the frontier with one province's strength, making the crisis into engineering and ledgers — one invented a new vessel outside the system, the other pushed the old system to its limit. The one shows crisis can breed new political imagination; the other, that procedural tenacity of the individual within crisis is itself provision for history.

cross_references.description_zh: 林则徐与马可·奥勒留同把'自我治理'当作公共责任的底层设施：奥勒留以斯多葛的'二分法'把可控之事（自己的判断）与不可控之事（帝国的命运）分开，在权力中心保持内心秩序；林则徐以'苟利国家生死以'把祸福从决策中删除，在荣辱两端保持同一工作姿态——一个向内立宪，一个向外担当，都以不被外部评价支配的心智完成对时代的责任。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Zexu and Marcus Aurelius both made the governance of the self the substructure of public duty: Aurelius, by the Stoic dichotomy, parted what lies in his power (his own judgment) from what does not (the fate of the empire), keeping inner order at the center of power; Lin, by 'if it profits the nation, I would give my life,' deleted fortune from decision, keeping one working posture across honor and disgrace. One legislates inward, the other takes the burden outward; both discharged their duty to the age with a mind not ruled by external verdict.

modes.name_en: The Method of Knowing the Foreigner Before Confronting Him
modes.domain_zh: 与未知的强敌对抗之前，先把自己变成最了解对手的人：不许'天朝上国'的自负挡住情报——设译馆、雇通事、翻译西报与西书，把对手的地理、法律、军备与意图变成可核对的文本，再决定打还是谈；林则徐在广东开战前先做成了中国人第一部系统的西方知识工程
modes.domain_en: Before contending with an unknown and stronger enemy, first become the one who understands him best: let no pride of the Celestial Empire block intelligence — found a translation bureau, hire interpreters, render Western newspapers and books into Chinese, turn the adversary's geography, law, armament and intent into checkable texts, and only then decide to fight or to talk; before the war in Canton, Lin Zexu built the first systematic engineering of Western knowledge ever made by a Chinese official
modes.source_chapter: 道光十九年（1839）林则徐以钦差大臣驻粤，在十三行设译馆，聘袁德辉、梁进德等四名译员，翻译《澳门新闻纸》三百余则、瑞《世界地理大全》成《四洲志》、译《华事夷言》与滑达尔《各国律例》选段——他本是奉旨禁烟的封疆大吏，却同时是当时中国最系统地阅读西方的人；魏源后来在此基础上扩成《海国图志》
modes.key_quote_zh: 只有先知道敌人是谁，才谈得上战胜敌人——先悉夷情，方可驱夷
modes.key_quote_en: "Only when you know who the enemy is can you speak of defeating him: first know the foreigner, then drive him out."
process_zh: 承认无知：把'我们不怯敌，但我们不了解敌人'摆上桌面，破除'化外蛮夷不足深究'的成见——无知本身是最大的战略风险
建制采集：不靠零散传闻，设固定机构（译馆）与固定人力（专职译员），把情报变成持续的日常生产而非临时抱佛脚
翻译即测绘：优先翻译对手的地理（《四洲志》）、法律（《各国律例》）、言论（《华事夷言》）与动态（《澳门新闻纸》）——对敌情的了解精确到对方的法律依据与舆论风向
以情报定策：军事部署、外交照会与具结谈判全部建立在对译文本之上——照会中引用万国律例斥责鸦片贸易，正是情报转化为行动的示范
process_en: Admit ignorance: put on the table 'we do not fear the enemy, but we do not know him,' and shatter the prejudice that 'outer barbarians merit no study' — ignorance itself is the greatest strategic risk

Build the apparatus: not scattered hearsay but a standing bureau (the translation office) with standing personnel (dedicated translators), making intelligence a continuous daily production, not a cram before the exam

Translation as surveying: translate first the enemy's geography (the Gazetteer of the Four Continents), his law (selections of Vattel), his voice (Words of the Barbarians) and his pulse (the Macao News sheets) — knowledge precise down to the enemy's legal grounds and the drift of his press

Let intelligence set the strategy: military dispositions, diplomatic notes and the bond negotiations all rest on the translated texts — the note citing the law of nations against the opium trade is intelligence converted into action
representative_cases_zh: 设译馆译《四洲志》（1839）：钦差行辕之内设译馆四译员，译出三十余国地理政情——这是林则徐军事外交部署的知识底座，也是后来《海国图志》的母本
照会义律引万国律例（1839）：致英国王的照会中引用国际法指责鸦片贸易'以害人之物骗人财货'——用对手自己的法理打对手，情报工程直接变成外交武器
日读《澳门新闻纸》（1839-1840）： battlefield 之外坚持逐日翻译外报，掌握英舰动向与伦敦政局——战争爆发前林则徐是唯一持续追踪对手舆论的清朝大吏
representative_cases_en: Founding the bureau and the Gazetteer of the Four Continents (1839): four translators in the Commissioner's yamen rendered the geography and politics of thirty-odd states — the knowledge base of every military and diplomatic move, and the seed of Wei Yuan's later Illustrated Treatise

The note to Palmerston citing the law of nations (1839): his message to the King of England quoted international law against a trade 'that cheats men of their wealth with goods that poison them' — striking the adversary with his own jurisprudence, intelligence turned weapon

Daily reading of the Macao News (1839-1840): through the crisis he had foreign papers translated day by day, tracking the movements of British ships and the politics of London — the only Qing statesman who continuously followed the adversary's own press before the war
modern_applications_zh: 企业进入新市场前的'译馆工程'：并购或对抗前先系统研究对手的财报、专利、组织与文化——情报预算优先于广告预算
诉讼前的证据测绘：律师不先谈策略，先穷尽对方公开文件、判例与证词——'悉夷'式的尽职调查决定打什么官司
安全团队的威胁建模：防御者先做攻击者画像（能力、意图、路径），把'不知己不知彼'变成结构化的情报看板再谈布防
modern_applications_en: The translation bureau before market entry: before an acquisition or a contest, study the rival's filings, patents, organization and culture as a system — the intelligence budget precedes the advertising budget

Evidence surveying before litigation: counsel maps the opposing side's public documents, precedents and testimony before speaking of strategy — due diligence of the 'know the foreigner' kind decides what case to fight
Threat modeling for defenders: security teams profile the attacker's capability, intent and paths first, turning 'unknown unknowns' into a structured intelligence board before deploying defenses

modes.name_en: The Method of Staking Life and Fortune on the National Good
modes.domain_zh: 在'做了必得罪人、不做必误国'的决策关口，把个人祸福从决策函数中整个删去：'苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之'——先认定该不该做，再接受做完之后落到自己头上的一切；这一决策姿态使林则徐敢在满朝观望时受命于最凶险的差事，也使他在被构陷革职时不怨不馁
modes.domain_en: At the decision point where acting must offend and not acting must harm the nation, delete personal fortune from the decision function entirely: 'If it profits the nation, I would give my life; why should I shun it because of woe or weal' — first settle whether the thing ought to be done, then accept whatever falls afterward upon one's own head; this stance let Lin Zexu take the most perilous commission while the whole court watched and wavered, and kept him unresented and unbowed when he was framed and stripped of office
modes.source_chapter: 道光十八年（1838）黄爵滋疏请重治吸食，朝中弛禁与严禁两派相持，道光帝连召林则徐八次入对；林则徐力陈'鸦片流毒天下，法当从严，若犹泄泄视之，是使数十年后中原几无可以御敌之兵，且无可以充饷之银'，遂受钦差大臣关防赴粤，自出京时即抱定'死生命也，成败天也'之志；后被构陷革职、发往伊犁，途中奉旨赴河南治河，工竣仍遣戍，'苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之'正是《赴戍登程口占示家人》之句
modes.key_quote_zh: 苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之
modes.key_quote_en: "If it profits the nation, I would give my life; why should I shun the duty because of woe or weal?"
process_zh: 把问题还原为'该不该'：剔除'做了我会怎样'的算计，只问'不做国家会怎样'——先立是非，再论生死
公开表明姿态：受命之前就把自己的判断与代价说破（'中原几无御敌之兵'），让支持与反对都冲着主张来，而不是冲着人算计
以家书立遗嘱式交底：出京赴粤即示家人'死生命也'——把最坏结局先接住，行动时便无后顾之私
祸福降临时不改判断：革职、遣戍、代过，皆不翻案自辩以媚时局——守的是当初判断的完整，不是自己的官位
process_en: Reduce the question to 'ought it be done': strike the calculation 'what will it cost me' and ask only 'what will it cost the nation if I do not' — settle right and wrong first, life and death after

Declare the stance in the open: before taking the commission, state the judgment and its price ('in a few decades there will be no soldiers to defend the realm'), so that support and opposition aim at the position, not at the man
Settle the worst in advance: leaving the capital he wrote home 'life and death are fate' — by taking the worst outcome into his arms beforehand, he leaves no private fear to steer the deed

When fortune falls, do not recant: stripped of office, exiled, made scapegoat — he did not reverse his judgment to flatter the times; what he guarded was the integrity of the original judgment, not his own rank
representative_cases_zh: 八次入对力主严禁（1838）：弛禁派势大、鸦片利益盘根错节，林则徐不揣摩上意、只陈利害——'数十年后中原几无可以御敌之兵，且无可以充饷之银'一语定策
虎门受命（1838-1839）：钦差南下即遭不断加码的阻力与威胁，他以'原知此役乃蹈汤火'自任——把最凶险的差事当成本分而非恩宠
遣戍途中治水复遣（1841-1842）：因战败被构馅革职、发往伊犁，途中奉命赴开封堵黄河决口——功成之日即再上戍途，无一句怨言，留诗明志
representative_cases_en: Eight audiences to urge prohibition (1838): with the legalization faction strong and the opium interest entrenched, he never angled for the emperor's mood but laid out the stakes — 'in a few decades there will be no soldiers to defend the realm, nor silver to pay the armies,' and the policy was set

Taking the Canton commission (1838-1839): southward he met resistance and threats that mounted daily; he took the post as 'walking into fire and water' — the most perilous errand accepted as duty, not favor

Flood control on the road to exile (1841-1842): framed after the defeat and banished to Ili, he was diverted mid-route to seal the Yellow River breach at Kaifeng — and on the day the work was done resumed his journey to the frontier, without one word of grievance, leaving the verse that states the creed
modern_applications_zh: 高管做'必得罪人'的决策：裁员、召回、披露问题——把'对我仕途的影响'从决策变量里删掉，只评估'对公司是否必要'，然后承担全部后果
科学家与工程师的公共表态：在利益集团施压下（药品安全、工程隐患）坚持出具真实结论——先定专业是非，再承受职业代价
危机中的临危受命：明知接手即背锅仍接手烂摊子——'祸福外置'恰恰是组织在最需要人时能找到人的原因
modern_applications_en: The executive's decision that must offend: layoffs, recalls, disclosure of bad news — strike 'what this does to my career' from the variables, weigh only 'what this does to the company,' then bear the whole consequence
The professional's public stand: under pressure from entrenched interests — drug safety, engineering flaws — deliver the true finding; settle the technical right first, accept the career cost after

Taking command in crisis: knowing the rescuer inherits the blame, take the broken situation anyway — it is exactly this outward displacement of fortune that makes people findable when organizations need them most
modes.definition_zh: 在'做了必得罪人、不做必误国'的决策关口，把个人祸福从决策函数中整个删去：'苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之'——先认定该不该做，再接受做完之后落到自己头上的一切；这一决策姿态使林则徐敢在满朝观望时受命于最凶险的差事，也使他在被构陷革职时不怨不馁
modes.definition_en: At the decision point where acting must offend and not acting must harm the nation, delete personal fortune from the decision function entirely: 'If it profits the nation, I would give my life; why should I shun it because of woe or weal' — first settle whether the thing ought to be done, then accept whatever falls afterward upon one's own head; this stance let Lin Zexu take the most perilous commission while the whole court watched and wavered, and kept him unresented and unbowed when he was framed and stripped of office

modes.name_en: The Method of Cutting the Source with Iron Hand Through Due Procedure
modes.domain_zh: 面对盘根错节的既得利益，既不空喊决心、也不诉诸私刑，而是把'铁腕'装进'程序'里：先断源头（勒令夷商具结永不再来）、再封藏所（封锁商馆收缴鸦片）、后公开销毁（虎门挖池化烟，二十三天销烟二百三十七万斤）——每一步都有谕令、有期限、有见证，让最大的强硬也可被外界检验；虎门销烟由此既是一次雷霆行动，又是一场经得起对手与历史核对的公开执法
modes.domain_en: Before entrenched interests, neither shout resolve nor descend to private violence: put the iron hand inside due procedure — first cut the source (commanding the foreign merchants to bond never to bring opium again), then seal the depot (blockading the factories to force surrender of the drug), finally destroy it in the open (pools dug at Humen, lime and sea water, 23 days, 2.37 million catties) — every step under edict, deadline and witnesses, so that even the hardest stroke remains inspectable by the adversary and by history; the Humen destruction was thus at once an act of thunder and a public execution of law that could bear being checked
modes.source_chapter: 道光十九年（1839）三月林则徐抵粤：谕令各国夷商限期交烟并具结'嗣后来船永不敢夹带鸦片，如有带来，一经查出，货尽没官，人即正法'；义律抗拒，即下封舱、撤买办、围商馆之令，收缴鸦片19,187箱又2,119袋共2,376,254斤；四月二十二日起在虎门海滩挖池两口，引海水入池，撒盐成卤、投石灰沸解，历时二十三日全部销毁，中美商馆人员与外船船长受邀现场参观——全程谕旨、告示、清册俱在
modes.key_quote_zh: 若鸦片一日未绝，本大臣一日不回，誓与此事相始终，断无中止之理
modes.key_quote_en: "So long as one ounce of opium remains, this commissioner will not withdraw; I vow to see this matter through to the end, and there is no halting halfway."
process_zh: 锁定源头而非末端：不烧烟馆不抓烟民开场，直取缴存鸦片的夷商与趸船——切断供给比惩罚消费更接近问题根子
以具结把一次性收缴变成长期制度：'货尽没官、人即正法'写进永不夹带的保证书，把个案执法升级为可持续的规则约束
强硬全程留痕：封舱、围馆、收缴、销毁每一步都有谕令与告示先行——强硬的合法性来自程序留痕，而不是来自暴力本身
公开执行以服众：销烟不秘密不私毁，挖池引水、邀外人现场观看——让销毁本身成为对内对外的公开证明
process_en: Lock the source, not the tail: begin not by burning dens and arresting smokers but by seizing the opium held by the foreign merchants and receiving ships — cutting supply sits closer to the root than punishing consumption

Turn one seizure into standing rule by the bond: 'cargo confiscated, men executed' written into a sworn pledge never to carry opium again — a single enforcement upgraded into a durable constraint of rules

Leave the hard hand on the record: blockade, enclosing the factories, surrender, destruction — each step preceded by edict and proclamation; the legitimacy of hardness comes from the paper trail, not from violence itself

Destroy in the open to convince all: no secret burning, no private disposal — pools dug, sea water let in, foreign captains invited to watch; the destruction itself becomes the public proof, at home and abroad
representative_cases_zh: 限期具结与封锁商馆（1839年3-4月）：先礼后兵——先谕令交烟具结，义律拖延即断供应、撤役收馆，十八日内收缴鸦片二万余箱而未伤一人
虎门销烟二十三日（1839年6月）：不是一烧了之——海水浸化、石灰沸解、退潮入海，昼夜分期销毁，销一箱清一册，外人现场参观后无话可说
依法驳斥鸦片贸易（1839年照会）：封锁与销毁的同时以《各国律例》为据发照会——行动与法理并行，强硬始终站在文本之上
representative_cases_en: The deadline, the bond and the blockade (March-April 1839): courtesy first, then force — an edict to surrender and bond; when Elliot stalled, supply cut and the factories enclosed; within eighteen days over twenty thousand chests were surrendered without a life lost

Twenty-three days of destruction at Humen (June 1839): not one bonfire — seawater soaking, lime dissolving, the tide carrying it away, destroyed in shifts day and night, one ledger cleared per chest; foreign witnesses left without a word of protest

The note against the opium trade (1839): while blockading and destroying, he issued the diplomatic note on the strength of the law of nations — action and jurisprudence in parallel, hardness standing always on text
modern_applications_zh: 治理数据造假与灰色供应链：不罚款末端店铺，直接断平台源头、冻结账户并要求'具结式'合规承诺——断源+留痕+公示
公司清理腐败供应商：先限期自查申报、再冻结往来、后公开除名——每一步书面化，让最重的处理也经得起仲裁
监管机构的市场整顿：约谈、限期整改、公开销毁违规产品并邀请媒体见证——把执法做成可核查的公开程序而非运动式风暴
modern_applications_en: Policing gray supply chains: fine not the corner shop but cut the platform source, freeze accounts, and require bond-style compliance pledges — cut the source, keep the record, publish the result
Purging a corrupt vendor: deadline for self-disclosure first, freeze of dealings second, public delisting third — every step on paper, so the heaviest sanction survives arbitration
Regulator's market sweep: summoned talks, deadlines, public destruction of infringing goods with press as witnesses — enforcement as an inspectable public procedure, not a campaign of storm

modes.name_en: The Method of Learning from the Foe Before Advocating It
modes.domain_zh: 在'学习敌人'尚属大忌的时代，把购买与仿制对手的器物做成先例：不空谈'师夷长技'的主义，先一手买西洋炮、雇船工、译火器书、造新式战船——把'向敌人学习'从可议的立场变成既成的事实；林则徐是'师夷长技以制夷'的先行者，魏源后来只是把他的实践写成纲领
modes.domain_en: In an age when 'learning from the enemy' was itself taboo, turn the buying and copying of the foe's instruments into accomplished fact: not proclaim the doctrine of 'learning the foreigners' superior techniques' but buy the western guns first, hire the shipwrights, translate the manuals on firearms, build the new-style warship — making 'learning from the adversary' no longer a debatable position but an established fact; Lin Zexu walked ahead of the slogan 'learn the superior techniques of the foreigners to control them,' and Wei Yuan merely wrote his practice into a program
modes.source_chapter: 1839-1840年林则徐在粤购西洋船炮：买甘米力治号商船改作战船，购西洋大炮二百余门装备虎门各台，仿造西式船舰与火炮，雇美国船员操演；翻译欧几里得、大炮瞄准法等书籍；主张'剿夷八字要言：器良、技熟、胆壮、心齐'；后被贬时将收集的西方资料交魏源，嘱其编纂《海国图志》——'师夷长技以制夷'即出于此
modes.key_quote_zh: 剿夷无他法，八字要言而已：器良、技熟、胆壮、心齐
modes.key_quote_en: "There is no other way to drive out the foreigner than eight characters: good weapons, practiced skill, stout hearts, united minds."
process_zh: 把主义降格为采购单：'师夷'不辩论，直接列出要买什么、雇谁、仿什么——行动先于舆论，事实先于立场
从翻译到仿制的完整链条：译书（火器、瞄准、船艺）→购置（炮、船）→仿造（新式战船）→操演（雇外人教练）——学习不是收藏文本而是形成能力
在体制缝隙里做试点：借钦差与督抚职权在广东一隅先行——不待全国共识，先造出一个可复制的样本
把积累移交后来者：去职时将译稿、图籍、心得全部交魏源——个人的先声变成时代的纲领，学习工程不随人去而中断
process_en: Demote the doctrine to a purchase list: no debate over 'learning from the foreigners' — simply list what to buy, whom to hire, what to copy; action precedes opinion, fact precedes position

A full chain from translation to replication: render the books (firearms, gunnery, seamanship) → purchase (cannon, ships) → copy (new-style vessels) → drill (hire foreign instructors) — learning is not the collecting of texts but the forming of capability
Pilot within the cracks of the system: using the powers of commissioner and governor to act first in one corner of the empire — without waiting for national consensus, produce a replicable sample
Hand the accumulation to successors: on leaving office he gave Wei Yuan all the translations, charts and notes — a private prelude becomes a public program, and the learning project survives the man
representative_cases_zh: 购'甘米力治'号改装战舰（1840）：买下剑桥号商船装炮改舰，购西洋炮二百余门布防虎门——清朝官员第一次系统地把'买敌人的船'变成防御工程
编译火器与船艺书籍（1839-1840）：译介大炮瞄准法、战船图式并组织仿造——器物学习的完整流程在钦差行辕内运转
嘱魏源编《海国图志》（1841）：遣戍途中把《四洲志》及全部外情资料交魏源——三年后'师夷长技以制夷'从他的实践变成半个世纪的思想纲领
representative_cases_en: Buying and converting the Cambridge (1840): a purchased merchantman re-gunned as a warship, two hundred-odd western cannon mounted on the Bogue forts — the first systematic conversion of 'buy the enemy's ships' into a defensive project by a Qing official
Translating gunnery and shipcraft (1839-1840): manuals of aiming and ship design rendered, copying organized — the full pipeline of instrumental learning running inside the commissioner's yamen

Entrusting Wei Yuan (1841): on the road to exile he handed over the Gazetteer of the Four Continents and all his foreign-intelligence papers; three years later 'learn the foreigners' superior techniques to control them' stood forth from his practice as the program of half a century
modern_applications_zh: 后发企业对标学习：不争论'该不该学对手'，先做拆机分析、专利研究、人才引进——用既成事实回应内部路线之争
技术追赶的国家工程：先买样机、先建中试线、先派人进对手工厂——纲领之争让位于试点事实
组织转型中的'先声项目'：改革派不空提理念，先做一个最小可行试点并把成果移交制度化——让实践成为下一步共识的底稿
modern_applications_en: Benchmarking for the latecomer: no debate whether to learn from the rival — teardown analysis, patent mapping and talent hiring first; facts answer the internal line struggle
National catch-up engineering: buy the prototype first, build the pilot line first, place engineers inside the rival's plants first; the contest of doctrines yields to the fact of pilots

The prelude project in organizational change: reformers do not preach but run one minimal viable pilot and institutionalize the handover of its results — practice becomes the draft of the next consensus

modes.name_en: The Method of Prohibition by Law and Procedure
modes.domain_zh: 禁绝一种深入社会肌理的毒品贸易，不靠运动式风暴而靠可重复的法律程序：谕令—限期—具结—搜缴—销毁—惩后，每一环写明标准与后果，对内对外一律适用；林则徐在广东把'严禁'从口号做成一套从谕旨到清册的流程，使空前规模的收缴不靠酷刑与株连也能完成
modes.domain_en: To stamp out a drug trade knit into the body of society, rely not on the storm of a campaign but on a repeatable legal procedure: edict — deadline — bond — search and seizure — destruction — penalty after; each link with its standard and consequence written down, applied alike within and without; in Canton Lin Zexu made 'strict prohibition' a pipeline from edict to ledger, so that a surrender of unprecedented scale was completed without torture or collective punishment
modes.source_chapter: 1839年林则徐在广东的禁烟流程：谕各国夷商呈缴鸦片并具结（永不敢夹带，违者'货尽没官，人即正法'）；对内则行连保法——五户邻右互结、窑口烟馆限期自首，'首缴免罪'；收缴鸦片的种类、箱数、斤两逐日造册；奏销折件与对外告示皆以既定章程为据——对外敢以国际法相争，对内能以自首宽免分化烟贩
modes.key_quote_zh: 法立而后令行——禁烟之事，先立章程，后施雷霆
modes.key_quote_en: "Law first, command after: in prohibiting opium, draft the statute before unleashing the thunder."
process_zh: 先立章程后动雷霆：把禁烟拆成写明期限、标准与后果的规程——让所有人预知违法代价，执法者自身也受规程约束
以具结把承诺变成可追责的契约：夷商签字画押'永不夹带'，违者按条款处置——把治理从反复博弈变成一次性可信承诺
用宽免分化存量：'首缴免罪'给烟贩与烟民出清出路——程序不仅惩罚，还设计退出通道，减少对抗面
全程造册留证：收缴鸦片逐日登记斤两箱数，奏销可核——程序的终点是可审计的账，而不是一次性政绩
process_en: Statute before thunder: break prohibition into a code with deadlines, standards and consequences written down — so all may foresee the price of breach, and the enforcer himself is bound by the code
The bond turns promise into enforceable contract: merchants sign 'never again to carry,' breach handled by the very terms — governance shifted from repeated games to a one-time credible commitment
Use amnesty to split the stock: 'surrender and be forgiven' opens an exit for traffickers and smokers — the procedure not only punishes but designs a way out, shrinking the front of resistance
Ledger everything: opium surrendered logged daily by chest and catty, memorials auditable — the end of procedure is an account that can be examined, not a one-time achievement
representative_cases_zh: 对外具结与对内连保并行（1839）：夷商具结'永不夹带'，广州民户五家互结、窑口限期自首——一套章程管住两个战场
收缴鸦片的逐日清册（1839）：两万余箱鸦片按日按箱登记造册、销毁与清册同步——空前的规模没有留下空前的糊涂账
'首缴免罪'分化烟贩：对限期自首的窑口与烟户免罪宽免——以程序设计的退出通道瓦解抵抗，而非一味严打
representative_cases_en: Bond without, mutual pledge within (1839): foreign merchants sign never to carry opium; households in Canton bind one another in fives, dens given deadlines to confess — one statute governing two battlefields
The daily ledger of surrender (1839): twenty thousand chests registered day by day, destruction matched to the ledger — unprecedented scale without an unprecedented muddle
Amnesty splitting the trade: dens and households surrendering within the term forgiven — a procedurally designed exit dissolving resistance where pure severity would have hardened it
modern_applications_zh: 公司合规体系建设：先出红线章程与申报宽免政策，再动稽查处罚——'首缴免罪'式的自首通道是低成本的清淤机制
平台治理灰色内容：公示规则—限期整改—阶梯处罚—全程留痕，让最重的封禁也经得起申诉复核
公共政策落地（垃圾分类、限塑）：先立可执行细则与宽限期，后启用处罚——程序完整性决定政策的可持续性
modern_applications_en: Building corporate compliance: publish the red-line code and an amnesty for disclosure before audits and sanctions begin — the surrender-and-be-forgotten channel is the cheapest dredging of the swamp
Platform governance of gray content: rules published, deadlines set, penalties stepped, everything logged — the heaviest ban must survive appeal and review
Landing public policy: enforceable细则 and a grace period before fines — the integrity of the procedure decides whether the policy outlives the campaign

modes.name_en: The Method of Real Coastal Defense
modes.domain_zh: 承认海上力量对比的悬殊，把备战从奏折语言落到工程清单：购炮、修台、练勇、造船、雇人教演——林则徐在广东的海防不是'民心可用'的空论，而是炮位编号、船艇编制与演练日程；他同时明白纯陆守不可恃，故主张'以守为战、以逸待劳'，并最早倡练水师、买船造船——边防思想从城墙时代转向海洋时代
modes.domain_en: Admit the disparity of naval power and bring war preparation down from memorial rhetoric to an engineering list: buy cannon, repair the forts, drill levies, build ships, hire instructors — the coastal defense of Canton was no empty talk of 'the people's hearts available,' but numbered gun positions, ship rosters and drill schedules; knowing pure land defense could not hold, he urged 'defend in order to fight, await the weary with the rested,' and was first to call for a modern navy — bought ships, built ships — turning frontier thought from the age of walls to the age of the sea
modes.source_chapter: 1839-1841年林则徐督粤海防：购西洋炮二百余门布置虎门、横档各台；雇美国船员教习舵水；改造甘米力治号为战船；添造快船、火船；组织水勇、渔艇协防；提出'剿夷八字'以器良为先；1841年革职后仍上折力言'海疆造船制炮'之要，遣戍途中致书友人言'剿夷八字'与船炮水军断不可少——后来左宗棠西征时犹按其议造船设局
modes.key_quote_zh: 船炮水军断不可少——海防之要，不在台不在墙，在船在炮在水师
modes.key_quote_en: "Ships, cannon and a navy are indispensable: the essence of coastal defense lies not in forts or walls but in ships, guns and a fleet."
process_zh: 先做力量对比的诚实评估：承认英舰'炮大船坚'的差距，不粉饰'夷船畏浅水'的传闻——备战的起点是对差距的准确丈量
把防务翻译成工程清单：多少门炮、哪几座台、何种船、雇何人教——每项有预算、有进度、有验收人
编新练旧两手并用：旧炮台加固与水勇渔艇协防同步，新式船炮购置仿制并行——在存量上补强、在增量上换血
败局中继续上书：战败革职不废其言——把败因归结为'无船无炮'的实证结论，为后人留下可执行的建设方案
process_en: Begin with an honest balance of forces: admit the enemy's 'great guns and strong ships,' refuse the rumor that 'foreign hulls fear shallow water' — preparation starts by measuring the gap exactly
Translate defense into an engineering list: how many guns, which forts, what ships, whom hired to teach — every item with budget, schedule and acceptor
Reinforce the old and build the new at once: old forts strengthened while fishing boats and levies are drilled; western guns bought while copies are made — patch the stock, renew the increment
Keep petitioning in defeat: stripped of office he still memorialized — the loss attributed, with evidence, to 'no ships, no guns,' leaving successors a buildable program
representative_cases_zh: 虎门布防工程（1839-1840）：与关天培添建炮台、增置西洋大炮、设拦江排链——珠江口防御体系按工程逻辑逐台布置
购船造船与雇员教演（1840）：改装甘米力治号、仿造西式船、雇外人操演——中国近代第一次成建制的舰船现代化尝试
遣戍途中论船炮（1841-1842）：代过治河后赴伊犁，途中反复致书陈述'船炮水军断不可少'——败仗被转化为国防建设的实证起点
representative_cases_en: The Bogue fortification project (1839-1840): with Guan Tianpei, new batteries built, western cannon mounted, river booms stretched — the Pearl River defense laid out by engineering logic, fort by fort
Buying, building and drilling (1840): the Cambridge converted, western-style vessels copied, foreign hands hired for the drill — China's first institutional attempt at naval modernization

On ships and guns en route to exile (1841-1842): after the flood works he wrote letter after letter — 'ships, cannon and a navy are indispensable' — defeat converted into the evidentiary starting point of national defense
modern_applications_zh: 技术弱势方的安全建设：不空喊'自研'也不躺平'买办'——外购与自研双轨，把安全预算按工程清单分解到可验收条目
网络安全防护体系：先诚实评估攻击面差距，再列控制项清单（补丁、隔离、演练、监控），定期红蓝对抗校准
企业的供应链韧性：不赌'断供不会发生'——替代供应商、关键库存、自研备胎同步推进，败局预演写入预案
modern_applications_en: Security-building for the technologically weaker: neither the empty cry of 'self-reliance' nor surrender to procurement — dual track of buying and building, the budget broken into inspectable line items
Cyber defense: measure the attack-surface gap honestly, then list controls — patching, isolation, drills, monitoring — calibrated by recurring red-team exercises
Supply-chain resilience: do not wager that cutoffs will not come — alternate suppliers, strategic stock, in-house fallbacks advanced in parallel, with the defeat rehearsed into the contingency plan

modes.name_en: The Method of Settling the Frontier by Working the Land
modes.domain_zh: 被贬到帝国最远的边陲，不把自己当作被废弃的人，而把流放地当作待治理的疆土：勘地、修渠、垦田、兴水利、教民纺织——林则徐在伊犁以戴罪之身勘垦南疆三万余顷，把'个人失意'转化为'边疆实利'；贬谪是处置一个人的方法，实边是他回应时代的方法
modes.domain_en: Banished to the empire's farthest frontier, refuse to be a discarded man and treat the land of exile as territory awaiting governance: survey the land, cut the canals, open the fields, build the waterworks, teach the people to spin and weave — in Ili, under sentence, Lin Zexu surveyed and opened thirty thousand qing of arable land in the southern march, converting 'personal defeat' into 'frontier substance'; exile was their method of disposing of a man; working the land was his method of answering the age
modes.source_chapter: 1842-1845年林则徐遣戍伊犁：力倡'屯田实边'，捐资承修阿齐乌苏废渠龙口段，引喀什河水灌田；1844年奉旨勘勘南疆八城垦地，行程三万里，履勘库车、阿克苏、乌什、和田、叶尔羌等处，勘明可垦地数十万亩，奏请因地制宜分给回民耕种；'林公渠'‘林公井’(坎儿井推广)之名留于新疆——新疆至今传其兴利之绩
modes.key_quote_zh: 谪居正是君恩厚，养拙刚于戍卒宜——身在戍所，心在垦田
modes.key_quote_en: "Banishment is the sovereign's grace, my dullness suits a garrison soldier well — though posted to the frontier, my heart is on the fields."
process_zh: 把处境与任务分开：贬谪处置的是身份，不是能力——不自我放逐，接受现地的治理课题
从最实的水利入手：边疆一切生产以水为纲——修渠、凿井、引河，先解决'能不能活'再谈'能不能富'
勘察先行、因地制宜：三万里履勘逐城丈量，不拍脑袋定垦区——把奏请建立在每块地的实测之上
利益留给边民：垦成之田请旨分给回民耕种——治理的成绩以当地人的所得计，不以自己的功名计
process_en: Separate the situation from the mission: exile disposes of a status, not a capability — do not exile yourself; accept the governance problem of the place you are sent to
Begin from water, the realest thing: all frontier production hangs on water — canals, wells, river works; settle 'can men live here' before 'can they prosper'
Survey first, fit the locality: thirty thousand li measured city by city, no armchair demarcation — every petition grounded in the actual measurement of each field
Leave the benefit to the frontier people: fields opened he petitioned to distribute to the local cultivators — achievement reckoned by what the locals gained, not by rank restored
representative_cases_zh: 捐修阿齐乌苏渠龙口（1842-1844）：以戴罪之身捐资承修最艰险的渠首工程，木石填层、昼夜赶工——伊犁垦务由此全面铺开
南疆三万里勘地（1844-1845）：年逾六十率队履勘八城，荒漠戈壁逐块丈量，勘明可垦数十万亩并奏请分给回民——清朝南疆垦务史上最大的一次实地勘察
推广坎儿井与纺车：教民凿井取水、传授内地纺织——'林公井''林公车'以实物的形式留在边疆记忆里
representative_cases_en: Funding the dragon-mouth of the Aqisu canal (1842-1844): under sentence he pledged his own silver to repair the riskiest head-works, timber and stone in layers, working day and night — the Ili reclamation opened thence

Surveying thirty thousand li of the southern march (1844-1845): past sixty he led the measuring of eight cities across desert and gobi, tens of thousands of mu verified, petitioning that the fields go to the local cultivators — the largest field survey in the history of Qing reclamation in the south
Spreading the karez wells and spinning wheels: teaching the people to dig for water and to weave as in the interior — 'Lin's wells' and 'Lin's carts' remain in frontier memory as objects, not statues
modern_applications_zh: 高管被贬职后的'现地创造'：不把岗位调动当终点——把偏远分部、亏损单元做成试验田，用实绩重建话语权
专家的'流放式'转型：学术或职业受挫后转向基础性长期工程（数据库、开源项目、田野积累）——把失意的时间变成复利的资产
地方治理的'水利先导'：欠发达地区投资先修基础（路、电、水、网），再谈产业——治理顺序比资源多少更决定成败
modern_applications_en: The demoted executive's creation in place: treat the remote branch or loss-making unit as a test field and rebuild voice through results — a posting is not an ending
The exile-turn of the professional: after setback, turn to foundational long projects — datasets, open-source work, fieldwork — converting the years of disfavor into compounding assets
Water first in local development: in underdeveloped regions invest in roads, power, water and networks before industries — the order of governance matters more than the amount of resources

modes.name_en: The Method of Turning Foreigners to One's Own Use
modes.domain_zh: 在'华夷之辨'的时代敢用外国人办中国人的事：聘美国传教士伯驾治病、雇美国船员教习舵水、用通事译文书、循英国医生与商人的渠道买炮买船——以'事'划界而不以'人'划界：凡有利于禁烟、海防与实学者皆可为我所用，又始终以我为主（聘约、监督、验收皆自操）；开放不是仰人鼻息，而是把外部能力装进自己的流程
modes.domain_en: In an age of 'distinction between Hua and Yi,' dare use foreigners for China's business: engage the American missionary Peter Parker as physician, hire American sailors to teach helm and rigging, set interpreters to render documents, follow the channels of British doctors and merchants to buy guns and ships — draw the line by the task, not by the person: whatever serves prohibition, coastal defense and practical learning may be used, while mastery stays ours (contracts, supervision, acceptance all held in own hands); openness is not leaning on others' breath but fitting outside capability into one's own process
modes.source_chapter: 1839-1840年林则徐在粤：延美国传教士伯驾（Peter Parker）为其疝气诊治并译医书；雇美国船员（如甘明）教练水师舵水；通过美国商人购买剑桥号商船与西洋火炮；令袁德辉、梁进德等译员翻译外文书籍报刊——聘、雇、购、译四类'洋员'各按事用，皆由钦差衙门立约监督；同时严禁所雇之人夹带鸦片，'用其长而杜其弊'
modes.key_quote_zh: 用其所长，杜其所弊——洋员可用，事权在我
modes.key_quote_en: "Use their strengths, dam their abuses: foreign hands may be employed, but the reins stay in our hands."
process_zh: 以事定人：先列要办之事（治病、教演、译书、购炮），再找最合适的人——肤色国籍不进用人标准
立约与监督并设：聘用有契约、操演有验收、采买有查验——开放的同时以流程防止'客卿坐大'
用长与杜弊分离：借外国人之长（技艺、渠道、知识）与防外国人之弊（夹带、窥探）双轨并行——信任具体的人而非抽象的'洋'字
知识与设备的消化验收：买来的炮要试放，雇来的人要出徒，译来的书要校勘——外部输入以'能不能为我所用'为验收标准
process_en: Let the task define the person: first list the things to be done — healing, drilling, translating, buying guns — then find the fittest hands; complexion and nation enter no hiring standard

Contract and supervision together: engagements under written agreement, drills under acceptance, purchases under inspection — while opening the door, keep the process proof against a resident overlord

Use the strengths, dam the abuses in parallel: borrow the foreigner's craft, channels and knowledge while guarding against his smuggling and prying — trust concrete persons, never the abstract word 'foreign'
Digest and accept knowledge and equipment: bought guns test-fired, hired men graduated, translated books collated — the standard of acceptance is 'can it serve our use'
representative_cases_zh: 延伯驾治病并通医学（1839）：钦差以夷医治疝而不以为讳，并命译西医书籍——对'洋人'的取舍完全以事与知识为准
雇美员教习舵水与购剑桥号（1840）：美国船员上船教练、美商渠道购船购炮——海军启蒙的人才与装备都借自'夷'而不失其主
译员团队的知识生产（1839）：袁德辉、梁进德专司翻译，译有《各国律例》《华事夷言》《澳门新闻纸》——把外国人的嘴变成自己的耳朵和眼睛
representative_cases_en: Engaging Peter Parker (1839): the commissioner treated by a foreign physician without embarrassment, western medicine books ordered translated — judgment of 'foreigners' made wholly by task and knowledge

Hiring American instructors and buying the Cambridge (1840): foreign sailors drilling the crews, guns and hull bought through American merchant channels — the navy's first men and materiel borrowed from the very 'barbarians' without losing mastery

The translators' knowledge production (1839): Yuan Dehui and Liang Jinde rendering the law of nations, the barbarians' words and the Macao papers — a foreigner's mouth turned into one's own ears and eyes
modern_applications_zh: 企业的全球人才与供应商策略：关键岗位与关键技术全球采买，但架构、数据与验收留在自己手里——'用其长杜其弊'
跨国合规与情报网络：多国顾问、律所与本地线人并用，一切以合同、保密与复核约束——借外部能力而不让渡主权
开源与外部贡献者治理：欢迎外部代码与外部专家，但CI、评审与合并权限由本体掌握——开放以可验收为边界
modern_applications_en: Global talent and vendor strategy: buy key skills worldwide, but keep architecture, data and acceptance in-house — use their strengths, dam their abuses
Cross-border compliance and intelligence: advisors, firms and local informants of many nations, all bound by contract, confidentiality and review — borrow capability without ceding sovereignty
Governance of open-source contributors: welcome outside code and experts, but CI, review and merge authority stay with the core — openness bounded by acceptance

modes.name_en: The Method of Testing Claims Against Facts
modes.domain_zh: 对一切'据说'先验后信：夷船'畏浅水''腿不能弯'的传闻，他派船实测、找洋人当面核实；每收一箱鸦片先称重验真，每译一书先校勘比对——林则徐的'睁眼看世界'不是姿态而是方法：把道听途说降级为待验证命题，把验证结果升级为决策依据；谣言止于实测
modes.domain_en: Believe no 'it is said' before it is tested: the rumors that foreign ships 'fear shallow water' and that foreigners' 'legs cannot bend,' he sent boats to measure and asked foreigners to their faces; every chest of opium weighed and verified before receipt, every translated book collated before use — his 'opening the eyes to see the world' was not a posture but a method: downgrade hearsay to hypotheses awaiting test, upgrade test results into grounds of decision; rumor stops at the measurement
modes.source_chapter: 1839-1840年林则徐对传闻的实证处理：派船出海实测英舰吃水与机动，验证'夷船畏浅水'是否可靠；就'夷人腿足僵直'等流行说法求证于伯驾等外人；收缴鸦片逐箱过秤验色、取样封存；译书必核对版本来源；奏折中凡引外情皆注明出自何报何译——他把'验'字贯穿于军政的一切信息流
modes.key_quote_zh: 查一物必得其实，行一事必核其效——传闻不实证，不足为谋
modes.key_quote_en: "In examining a thing, get its truth; in doing a deed, verify its effect: hearsay untested is no ground for strategy."
process_zh: 把传闻列为待验证命题：凡'据说'一律不直接采信，先问'谁说的、怎么知道的、能不能测'——证伪与证实同样受欢迎
设计最小成本的检验：能派船实测的派船，能当面求证的求证，能称量的称量——验证方式与主张的风险等级相称
以来源标注支撑判断：奏折与部署中注明情报出自何报何译何人——判断的可追溯性让决策可以被复核也可以被纠正
检验结果与主张分离：证实则用，证伪则弃，存疑则再验——不因主张出自权威或出于自己也豁免检验
process_en: List rumors as propositions awaiting test: no 'it is said' accepted straight; ask first 'who says, how known, can it be measured' — refutation welcomed as warmly as confirmation
Design the cheapest sufficient test: send the boat where a boat will do, ask the foreigner where a face will do, weigh where a scale will do — the test matched to the risk of the claim
Anchor judgments in named sources: memorials and dispositions note which paper, which translation, which person — traceability lets decisions be re-checked and corrected
Keep the verdict separate from the claim: confirmed, use it; refuted, drop it; doubtful, test again — no authority, not even oneself, exempts a claim from the test
representative_cases_zh: 实测英舰与'畏浅水'说（1839-1840）：不轻信'夷船不能入内河'，派艇跟测英舰吃水与行动范围——防御布置按实测而非传闻
核验'夷腿不能弯'等流言：向伯驾等外人当面求证，将流行的轻敌笑话从军情判断中剔除——防止自欺进入决策
收缴鸦片逐箱过秤（1839）：两万余箱鸦片验色称重、取样封存、造册核销——没收品本身也是被检验对象
representative_cases_en: Measuring the English ships (1839-1840): disbelieving that 'foreign hulls cannot enter the inner waters,' he sent boats to follow and measure draft and range — the defense laid out by measurement, not rumor
Checking the tale of the unbending legs: verified face to face with Parker and other foreigners, striking the popular jeer out of military judgment — keeping self-flattery out of decisions
Weighing every chest (1839): twenty thousand chests of surrendered opium checked for color and weight, sampled, sealed and ledgered — even the confiscated goods stood under the test
modern_applications_zh: 情报与舆情工作的'验后信'：竞争情报、市场传闻一律标注来源与置信度，重大决策只采信实测过的结论
工程与安全的'实测文化'：性能声称必须复测（跑分、渗透、压测），采购验收以测试报告为据
组织的反自欺机制：定期把'我们都知道'的共识拿出来复核——流行的偏见在进入战略前先过一遍证伪流程
modern_applications_en: Believe after testing in intelligence: competitive and market claims tagged with source and confidence; major decisions rest only on measured conclusions
A culture of measurement in engineering and security: performance claims re-tested (benchmarks, penetration, load), procurement accepted on test reports alone
Organizational anti-self-deception: periodically re-verify what 'everyone knows' — popular bias passes a falsification step before it enters strategy
modes.definition_zh: 对一切'据说'先验后信：夷船'畏浅水''腿不能弯'的传闻，他派船实测、找洋人当面核实；每收一箱鸦片先称重验真，每译一书先校勘比对——林则徐的'睁眼看世界'不是姿态而是方法：把道听途说降级为待验证命题，把验证结果升级为决策依据；谣言止于实测
modes.definition_en: Believe no 'it is said' before it is tested: the rumors that foreign ships 'fear shallow water' and that foreigners' 'legs cannot bend,' he sent boats to measure and asked foreigners to their faces; every chest of opium weighed and verified before receipt, every translated book collated before use — his 'opening the eyes to see the world' was not a posture but a method: downgrade hearsay to hypotheses awaiting test, upgrade test results into grounds of decision; rumor stops at the measurement

modes.name_en: The Method of Self-Possession Beyond Praise and Blame
modes.domain_zh: 在荣誉顶点与惩罚谷底之间保持同一个工作姿态：受宠时无骄气（钦差权重而不揽权），受辱时无丧志（革职遣戍而治水垦田照做）——把外部评价与自我价值解耦，让'我该做什么'只由事本身决定；'海纳百川，有容乃大；壁立千仞，无欲则刚'既是自勉联语，也是这种人格工程的总纲
modes.domain_en: Keep one working posture between the summit of honor and the valley of punishment: no arrogance in favor (the commissioner's vast powers held without grasping), no despair in disgrace (stripped and banished, he still sealed the river and opened the fields) — decouple external verdict from self-worth, letting 'what ought I do' be decided by the thing alone; 'The sea receives a hundred rivers, its capacity makes it great; the cliff stands a thousand fathoms, without desire it is strong' is at once a couplet for his own wall and the general law of this personality engineering
modes.source_chapter: 林则徐自题堂联'海纳百川，有容乃大；壁立千仞，无欲则刚'；1838年受钦差之命时'知此役乃蹈汤火'而坦然成行；1841年因战败代过革职，'讥谗满耳'而不辩，赴浙东、赴河工、赴伊犁皆即行即做；1845年起复后历任陕西巡抚、云贵总督，力疾从事而不恋栈，1849年因病乞归——荣与辱两端的接续办事，构成其人格的同一曲线
modes.key_quote_zh: 海纳百川，有容乃大；壁立千仞，无欲则刚
modes.key_quote_en: "The sea receives a hundred rivers: its capacity makes it great. The cliff stands a thousand fathoms: without desire it is strong."
process_zh: 建立'事'与'我'的两本账：功劳记于事、错误记于我——受誉时清醒（事成有多方之功），受责时担责（己责不诿于势）
以自题联语立人格纲纪：把'有容''无欲'写成日日可见的座右——外部激励不可靠时，用自我立法维持姿态恒定
在变动中保持动作不变：任职、革职、复起，公文照写、工程照办、人照见——身份的变化不改变日程表的形状
退场也干净：病重即乞休，不恋栈、不布置身后党援——把'无欲'贯彻到权力的出口，人格工程才算闭环
process_en: Keep two ledgers, of the task and of the self: credit the deed's success to many causes, charge the deed's failure to oneself — sober in praise, self-charged in blame, never shifting fault onto the times
Legislate character in a couplet: 'capacity' and 'desirelessness' written where the eye falls daily — when external incentives fail, self-legislation keeps the posture constant
Keep the actions unchanged as status changes: in office, out of it, restored — memorials written, works run, people received; the shape of the schedule does not bend to the shape of the rank

Exit clean: gravely ill, he asked to resign — no clinging to office, no planting of clients behind him; carrying 'no desire' through the exit gate is what closes the circuit of the character engineering
representative_cases_zh: 钦差任上的不揽权（1839-1840）：节制广东水师、总办禁烟而事事以谕旨与章程为据——权重之际反而最守程序
革职代过期间的连轴实做（1841-1842）：赴浙东效力、开封治河、续行遣戍——从钦差到戍卒的落差中没有一天停工
晚年复起与急流乞归（1847-1849）：云贵总督任上平处理番汉冲突后，因病力请开缺回籍——顶点处主动退场，无欲则刚的最后注脚
representative_cases_en: Power without grasping (1839-1840): commanding the Canton fleet and the whole prohibition while every act rested on edict and statute — at the zenith of power, closest to the procedure

Continuous real work under disgrace (1841-1842): service on the Zhejiang coast, the flood works at Kaifeng, then on to exile — from commissioner to garrison soldier, not one day's work lost in the fall

Restoration and the willing exit (1847-1849): governing Yunnan-Guizhou, settling the conflicts of natives and settlers, then begging leave for home as illness pressed — retiring himself at the summit, the last word of 'without desire, strong'
modern_applications_zh: 职业经理人的荣辱解耦：项目成败归因清晰（团队之功、己之过），晋升或边缘化都不改变工作质量——用个人章程代替外部激励
创始人的进退纪律：公司巅峰期主动交棒、退居顾问——把'无欲则刚'用在权力的出口处
专业人士的声誉管理：舆论捧杀与棒杀都视为噪音——用可验证的工作产品回应评价，而不是用回应评价生产工作
modern_applications_en: The manager decoupled from verdicts: attribution clear — the team's credit, one's own fault; promotion or sidelining leaves quality untouched — a personal statute in place of external incentives
The founder's discipline of exit: hand over at the company's peak, remain as advisor — 'without desire, strong' applied at the gate of power
The professional's repute: both applause and vilification treated as noise — answer evaluation with verifiable work, not work with responses to evaluation
